hardware_classes.description: AMD Renoir/Cezanne APU — 16 threads CPU, 29 GB RAM, 4 GB VRAM + 19 GB GTT (unified)

notes: GTT (mapped system RAM) + 4 GB dedicated VRAM reported as unified 22 GiB pool
flash-attn: requires runtime probe — RADV support varies by mesa version
KV quantization (-ctk/-ctv): supported on Vulkan in llama b9600+
No CUDA/ROCm — Vulkan compute only (ggml-vulkan backend)

cpu.note: governor should be set to 'performance' during inference for best throughput

weight_budget.note: For single-model load: weights + KV(f16) must fit in vulkan_pool_mib. For concurrent backends: sum of active models must fit.
